title: Simultaneous low- and high-mass star formation in a massive protocluster: ALMA observations of G11.92-0.61<SUP>★</SUP>
question: Do low-mass cores exist within the accretion reservoir of the massive protostars in G11.92-0.61, and are low- and high-mass stars forming simultaneously?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 0.35 mJy/beam representative (0.25 to >0.5 varying)

what.value: Dust opacity kappa_1.05mm = 1.45 cm2/g (thick ice mantles)

evidence.quote: we adopt $\kappa_{\rm 1.05mm}=$1.45 cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$, for grains with thick ice mantles in regions of high gas density (cite: OH94)

what.value: MM1 and MM6 outflow properties from 12CO(2-1) SMA

evidence.quote: MM1 outflow: from (cite: C11sma), rescaled for D=3.37 kpc.

recipe.goal: Build continuum image and detect sources
recipe.method: Line-free pseudo-continuum, multi-frequency synthesis, self-calibration; sources >5 sigma local rms
Two-dimensional Gaussian fits (single or multiple components) for peak, integrated flux, size

recipe.goal: Derive core masses, densities, free-fall times
recipe.method: Isothermal dust emission with opacity correction
assumptions: gas-to-dust 100, kappa 1.45 cm2/g, T_dust 20 K, D 3.37 kpc, mu_H2 2.8, spherical

recipe.method: Optically thin mass per channel in 3 sigma moment-0 masks; momentum, energy, dynamical times
assumptions: T_ex=30 K, X_CO=1e-4, X_H2CO=1e-8, v_LSR=35 km/s, no inclination correction

evidence.quote: with a median mass of 1.3 M$_{\odot}$ and a median radius of $\sim$1600 au
the median offset from MM1 of the low-mass cores is $\sim$0.17 pc

evidence.loc: 4.1 Low-mass cores in a massive protocluster
evidence.quote: The total mass of the newly-detected ALMA sources MM4..MM19 is $\sim$22 M$_{\odot}$, or $\sim$3% of the ATLASGAL clump mass
We measure an integrated flux density of 11.0$\pm$0.3 Jy from the ATLASGAL 870 $\mu$m map

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges and the exact threshold adopted
Self-calibration solution intervals and number of iterations
Cell size, image size, clean threshold and masks
Source-finding procedure beyond the local 5 sigma criterion
SMA and VLA calibration details (only in earlier papers)
Software used for Gaussian fitting beyond CASA IMFIT
missing_for_reproduction: Cell and image sizes, clean settings
score_reason: Public data and clear calculation recipe, but imaging and self-calibration details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data; source table and mass equations with stated assumptions allow redoing the numeric results.
